configure.description: Stop {stop_name} ({stop_code}). Line and direction are optional. Leave them empty to follow every tram at this stop.

data_description.direction: Direction 1 and 2 depend on the line. On Line 1, 1 is towards La Trinidad and 2 towards Intercambiador. On Line 2, 1 is towards La Cuesta and 2 towards Tíncer.
